name: Asset Alchemist
title: Cinematic Media Overdrive — Local GIF/Video Covers & Background Visual Pop
subtitle: High-fidelity thumbnail motion, vivid local backgrounds and improved iPhone video artwork
features: High-resolution 960×540 video poster images for all personalized master and studio thumbnail slots, replacing low-fidelity default snapshots.
Adjustable visual vibrancy, contrast, background brightness, panel transparency and safe iPhone/PC animated thumbnail profile, with one-click Cinematic Pop preset.
One-click saved background visibility boost to 85% while retaining locally stored original media and player contrast.
Independent GIF, MP4, WebM, PNG, JPEG or WebP artwork cover per saved Video Vault movie; muted video covers animate only in the current viewport subject to iPhone decoder limits.
New Video Vault current-frame cover button with 960×540 JPEG snapshots; personal cover reset does not delete original video, collection or metadata.
No new studios, no external video downloading and no external media uploads. The existing OPFS/IndexedDB local video data is preserved.
All current Media Theater, Animation Forge, Reactor/Sonic, large-file Video Vault, mobile layout and privacy features remain.

Personal Home Screen Icon Studio: export 180/512 PNG icons from user art or saved Master, with zoom/focus control, offline previews and separate iPhone Shortcuts vs native web-app installation instructions; existing installed icons do not update automatically.
